facts.fact: The IEG review says LGRCIS automates billing through bar codes on invoices, and by project closure taxpayers in all project cities had electronic bills and electronic receipts; before the project billing and receipts were manual.
LGRCIS was developed under the Strategic Cities Project for its 8 participating LGAs, closing 26 November 2020, where taxpayers had electronic bills and receipts.
The ICR as reported by IEG says LGRCIS was scaled up from 8 LGAs to all 185 LGAs in mainland Tanzania; the review states no use or date for the 185, so the document's publication date applies.
LGRCIS was developed under the World Bank-financed Strategic Cities Project (IDA credits, total cost USD 340.4 million) implemented through PO-RALG.
